record.kind: Three inline passive checks (chef stage start, eatBerry, applyDishEffects); no PassiveEffects entry
record.summary: Passive.GLUTTON has no PassiveEffects entry; three places read it. (1) Chef Hat: the chefCookEffect (registered only on Item.CHEF_HAT) runs at stage start for the holder; if the holder's passive is GLUTTON it calls chef.addMaxHP(30) on the board Pokemon (Pokemon.addMaxHP: hp = max(1, hp + 30), maxHP = hp), so a Munchlax/Snorlax needs a Chef Hat to get this +30 each stage. (2) Every berry eaten by the fighting entity (eatBerry, reached when a held berry is eaten below 50% HP or via the BERRY_EATER path) ends with applyStat(Stat.HP, 10, true): entity.addMaxHP(10, self, 0, false, permanent true), i.e. requested +10 max HP, rounded, increased by Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down, so 12) and, with Twist Band, unchanged for a positive value; the entity's maxHP and current hp rise by that applied value (no heal guard, no healDone) and the same applied value is added to the board Pokemon's maxHP unless it is a ghost opponent (the permanent flag passes the applied value, so the Belt bonus is also permanent). (3) Each dish consumed at simulation start (applyDishEffects) gives the board Pokemon +20 max HP (Pokemon.addMaxHP, raw) and the in-fight entity entity.addMaxHP(20, self, 0, false) (permanent false, so the Belt would make it 25 for the entity only while the board gets 20). The title check uses board hp > 750 (berry) or board maxHP > 750 (chef, dish). Amounts are requested raw values: +30 chef, +10 berry, +20 dish.
